1) Split into two 30m sessions (preferred) — reduces overlap friction and we can tailor a short live Q&A for infra.
2) Move the single 60m to Mon Mar 16 at 14:00 UTC (falls at 15:00 CET, 23:00 JST — borderline for APAC).
3) If you must keep a single demo earlier, Thu Mar 12 at 13:00 UTC works for US/EU but pushes APAC late.

Can you confirm which option you prefer? If split, I can propose exact slots and loop in our delivery engineer (Karthik) to confirm capacity and runbook.
